paper_reconciliation_last_success_timestamp_seconds and paper_request_budget_wait_exceeded_total are not exported by metrics.py because they are not durably recorded by the current safety.py/runner.py ledger schema; the corresponding clauses in EquitiesReconciliationFailed and EquitiesRequestBudgetExhausted are syntactically valid but currently dormant (see metrics.py module docstring for the exact gap).

paper_order_state_divergence_total only counts risk_halt events with reason=external_order_detected; runner.reconcile()'s position/cash/intent mismatches raise SafetyError without writing a ledger event and are not counted.

promtool/amtool were run against a temporary rendered config directory, not the operator's live $STACK_CONFIG_ROOT; no running Prometheus/Alertmanager instance evaluated these rules against real time-series data.
The alertmanager scope=equities-broker sub-route was checked with amtool check-config only; amtool's interactive route-matching simulation was not separately exercised in this receipt.
